new &

Spatial: agri reference panel divergence &
new &
The reference-year crop split measured proxy-vs-panel : within-province shares per (category, shape) under the MapSPAM/cropland proxy product and the PBS district crop panel the allocation reads. The record of what putting FY2023-24 on the panel changed, and of why field burning declined both panels for its own-year FIRMS raster - a measured disagreement, never a second allocation. \texttt{agri\_reference\_panel\_divergence.csv}. \\
Spatial: cube &
allocation, partly observed &
The 0.05 degree MONTHLY cube in native gas mass, with district and provincial views, for the reference year. The monthly grain is the reference year's alone; the ten fiscal years are gridded ANNUALLY in pakemis\_grid\_0p05\_annual\_ref\_fy2015\_16\_fy2024\_25.nc and tabulated at ADM1 and ADM2 in pakemis\_adm1\_by\_year.csv and pakemis\_adm2\_by\_year.csv. \texttt{pakemis\_grid\_0p05\_monthly.nc}. \\
Spatial: cube annual &
allocation, evidence-graded per stream and period &
Ten fiscal periods at 0.05 degrees, three spatial views, three gases, in native mass. Each period is generated from its own atomic streams, NOT by rescaling the reference year's map. Cells plus pakemis\_spatial\_unallocated\_by\_year.csv reproduce each period's national control. The views PARTITION the placed mass and must not be added to one another's totals. Whether a period's within-province pattern is its own or borrowed is stated per stream in pakemis\_spatial\_weights\_by\_year.csv. Four configuration-specific annual cubes and monthly administrative tables are published; the GHG monthly cube is reference-year only. \texttt{pakemis\_grid\_0p05\_annual\_ref\_fy2015\_16\_fy2024\_25.nc}. \\
Spatial: by year &
allocation, source-specific temporal evidence &
Ten fiscal years at ADM1 and ADM2, annually and monthly, under four configurations. Each stream records whether its geography is own-year evidence, fixed, borrowed or substituted. Allocation at district scale is not an observed district series. \texttt{pakemis\_adm1\_by\_year.csv}. \\
Spatial: unallocated &
declared, not gridded &
The mass with no defensible placement below ADM1, retained rather than spread. National closure is raster plus this. \texttt{pakemis\_spatial\_unallocated.csv}. \\
Spatial: configurations &
current &
All four configurations at ADM2; fixed within-year geography with source-period evidence and unallocated ledger. \texttt{pakemis\_ghg\_configuration\_adm2.csv}. \\
Uncertainty: reference year &
legacy, reference year &
The 100,000-draw national Monte Carlo for the FY2023-24 reference year, by module and sector, retained for continuity. The conditional native-gas intervals for every year and configuration, with paired trends, are pakemis\_ghg\_conditional\_uncertainty.csv and pakemis\_ghg\_trend\_uncertainty.csv. \texttt{national\_uncertainty\_montecarlo.csv}. \\
Uncertainty: common ensemble &
joinable, reference year &
A 10,000-draw prefix of the national Monte Carlo carried to months and provinces on one draw\_id, with both closure identities holding inside every draw. Profile weights are drawn only where a measured dispersion exists; allocation is conditional, never mixed. \texttt{pakemis\_ensemble\_summary.csv}. \\
Uncertainty: ghg native &
current &
Configuration-conditional native gases and separate GWP aggregates; paired trend ensemble; structural gaps excluded. \texttt{pakemis\_ghg\_conditional\_uncertainty.csv}. \\
Uncertainty: air &
current &
Conditional pollutant intervals with shared nitrogen, waste and combustion inputs; no probability assigned to structural scenarios. \texttt{pakemis\_air\_conditional\_uncertainty.csv}. \\
